sentences.en: In an emergency you can fall back on your savings.
sentences.zh: 在紧急情况下你可以依靠你的积蓄。

sentences.en: So we are saving up in order to buy them.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正在攒钱以便购买它们。

sentences.en: I'm saving up so that I can go to Australia.
sentences.zh: 我正在攒钱以便去澳大利亚。

senses.zh: 搭救，挽救，节约，存款，(复数)savings:储蓄金，存款
